promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-06 (nyiso-129). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-solar-basis (bundle results/calibration/nyiso128_treatment), superseding 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-control. THE ESCALATED SOLAR-BASIS TREATMENT IS ADJUDICATED AND PROMOTED, AND IT COSTS A DETERMINATION DOWNGRADE THAT IS CARRIED OPENLY: CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS -> NOT-YET, sole FAIL C3c-2023 (model 22 h vs RT actual 10 h, 2.20x OVER-produced, in-training so the 2026-08-06 C3c standing rule does not reach it). OWNER RULING, session nyiso-129, verbatim: 'Is this a recommended keeper candidate? If so plz promote. If structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper.' The session's recommendation was YES on rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE]. WHAT IS ARMED: nyiso_solar_market_generator_basis, a rule 14 input repair with ZERO free parameters (n_residual unchanged at 6) correcting a genuine DOUBLE COUNT — EIA-860's NY utility-scale population carries ~2 GW of distribution-connected NY-Sun community solar that is not a NYISO market generator and is already netted out of the EIA-930 NYIS demand series used as load (NYIS 'NG: SUN' identically zero, 8,760/8,760 h). Capacity basis becomes NYISO's own Gold Book Table III-2a registry (15 units, 573.4 MW). WHAT IT BUYS: C3a PASSES ALL THREE YEARS and improves in the two years that were furthest out — +6.2 / -1.7 / -7.0 % -> +8.8 / +0.8 / -3.2 % (2025 +3.8 pp, 2024 +2.5 pp; 2023 worsens 2.6 pp but stays in band, and the pre-registered adverse case of 2023 crossing +10 % did NOT materialise). C1/C2/C3b/C4/C6/C8 all PASS; scored at HEAD under rubric v3.1. P1 confirmed (JJA h16-h18 2025 CT_PEAKER +109 MW, ST_GAS +365 MW, CC_REGULAR +142 MW against solar -1,218 MW); K5 exonerates the seam (import p50 +52 / 0 / +42 MW), so the removed solar is replaced by IN-STATE THERMAL. WHAT IT COSTS, AND WHY THAT IS RULE 14 WORKING AS WRITTEN: C3c-2023 goes 18 h -> 22 h. nyiso-129 LOCALIZED the regression rather than accepting it as diffuse: all four added hours are Long Island afternoon hours in ONE Sept 2023 heat-wave episode (09-04 16h, 09-07 15h, 09-09 14h/15h; the full 22-hour tail is Aug-21 plus Sept 4-9, every hour Zone K, h14-h19), and Zone K is where the arm removes 97.7 MW of 152.1 MW. Rule 14 states the reading explicitly — a more accurate input that makes the fit worse is a DISCOVERED BUG elsewhere, not a reason to revert: the phantom Zone-K solar was masking an over-tight Long Island representation, which is now the ISO's named successor lever (the queue was EMPTY before this session). The 2023 exception is STILL WITHHELD, not laundered — the miss is an over-production, the opposite sign to the C3c caveat's own classification, so it stands at full magnitude as a FAIL and the determination reads NOT-YET. The ledger budget stays 1 of 3; the ledgered C3c caveat (2024, 0.17x -> 0.25x, still an under-production) is carried forward unchanged in substance. THE nyiso-128b NAMED SUCCESSOR IS REFUTED AS SPECIFIED, ex ante and with no solve spent. That lever was 're-identify the registered fleet's CF from EIA-860 tracking mix + latitude', on the premise that the registered fleet's ~0.20 CF vs the model's 0.133 blend is a geometry difference. MEASURED: the clear-sky POA ratio (registered subset vs whole NY fleet, capacity-weighted tracking mix and centroid latitude, via renewables._clearsky_poa_by_tech) is 1.004 / 1.032 / 1.028 — the two populations sit at the same latitude (42.54 vs 42.69 N) and differ only modestly in tracking share (61 % vs 47 % single-axis), and the registered fleet's DC:AC ratio is LOWER (1.340 vs 1.353). Geometry buys CF 0.133 -> 0.137, so the lever as named is INERT and rule 26 [R-DELETE] forbids parking it. THE REAL OBJECT, newly identified: RENEWABLE_AVG_CF['NYISO']['solar'] = 0.15 is a self-declared Tier-3 approximation carrying 'needs-citation: verify against EIA-923 ISO totals', realized at ~0.133, against a MEASURED 19.5 % for the very fleet this keeper installs (2026 Gold Book Table III-2a per-unit 2025 Net Energy, 981.8 GWh over 573.4 MW, per-unit range 15.8-22.2 %). That is a CF-LEVEL defect on a different input with its own identification, not a geometry correction. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso129-solar-basis-promotion-and-cf-successor-2026-08-06.md, FINDING-nyiso128-market-solar-basis-2026-08-06.md, PREREG-nyiso128-market-solar-basis-2026-08-05.md, _nyiso128_ab_gates.json, _nyiso129_cf_identification.json.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
